turns.text:
I fixed the bug and all 441 tests now pass. `IndexedSet.__getitem__` converted negative indexes to positive ones, and then `_get_real_index` converted them a second time. So an out-of-range negative index like `x[-10]` wrapped around to a real element instead of raising, and `pop(-15)` could quietly remove a middle element.

In `boltons/setutils.py`, I removed the extra conversion from `__getitem__` and made `_get_real_index` raise `IndexError` when the converted index falls outside `0 <= index < len(self)`. Because `pop` uses the same helper, it now rejects out-of-range indexes too.
